headline: RBI extends Abhyudaya Co-op Bank board supersession by a year
summary: The Reserve Bank of India extended the supersession of the board of directors of Mumbai-based Abhyudaya Co-operative Bank by one year, effective November 24, 2026, in the public interest. The board was first superseded in 2023 over governance deficiencies.
why: The RBI regulates co-operative banks and can supersede their boards when governance problems arise. Such actions affect depositors and the bank's management control.
